heading: About
paragraphs: I'm a fifth-year student at Epitech, moving towards IoT, embedded systems and connected devices.

C++ is my strongest language: among other things, I used it to write a game engine with my team on R-Type. I'm comfortable on Linux, on the command line, and with Git and Docker. I also come from software development: on Melo, my end-of-studies project, I'm the backend tech lead.

I spent a year in South Korea, speaking English every day: very comfortable speaking and reading, solid in writing. I'm looking for a six-month end-of-studies internship from March 2027, with a view to a permanent position.
